content:
nina: dropped a small update to routing editor sandbox. key changes: move up/down buttons, compact rows, and an inline validation shimmer. quick eyes?
asher: compact rows look good on desktop. mobile padding feels tight, recommend 12px vertical.
lia: copy: the inline warning currently says 'Invalid priority'. suggest: 'Priority conflict: two rules use the same index. Click to locate.'
nina: good — also thinking inline warnings that don't block save unless unresolved. show an 'Unsaved changes' badge.
asher: keyboard: move buttons need aria-labels and the list should announce reorder via aria-live. also make priority inputs spinbuttons.
ux-bot: a11y checklist: move controls must have 44px hit area and visible focus. see https://intranet.redwood/ux/a11y.
deploy-bot: sim-service v2 deployed to sandbox at 1769990060 with streaming previews enabled.
lia: preview: instead of one total, show top 3 sample matches with matched rule id. helpful for triage.
asher: i'll implement progressive append from streaming chunks and cancel on edits.
nina: can we do a quick 15-min playtest tomorrow 9am with Support? invite two folks.
lia: added to calendar. i'll update Figma copy and paste into the PR.
nina: thanks team — PR after a11y pass and demo GIF.
